newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grants free-mkt wheat, barley.
newsitem.headline: EU grants free-mkt wheat, barley.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted licences to export 480,000 tonnes of free-market soft wheat to non-EU countries at a maximum rebate of 9.30 Ecus per tonne, grain traders said.
The EU's grain panel meeting in Brussels also awarded licences for the export of 294,000 tonnes of free-market barley at a maximum rebate of 29.98 Ecus per tonne, they said.
The EU also granted licences for the export of 3,000 tonnes of free-market oats to Switzerland at a maximum rebate of 26.94 Ecus per tonne.
It also awarded licences for the export of 6,000 tonnes of free-market rye at a maximum rebate of 34.95 Ecus per tonne.
But it rejected bids to export free-market Greek maize, they said.
EU member country officials later confirmed the figures.
